caption:
UWS Briefly · Sep 17–23

• Two people went to the hospital after an escalator accident at the Trader Joe's on 72nd, ten days after it reopened.
• Four gunpoint robberies in Central Park in one night, all along East Drive. Three men, a gun and a bike.
• The Sweetgreen at 311 Amsterdam is permanently closed, three weeks after the roach shutdown.
• The last defendant in the sham construction-safety school case, tied to a worker's fatal fall on the UWS, pleaded guilty.
• 207 W. 75th, the building in an $845,000 illegal Airbnb settlement, went to a foreclosure auction.
• Aperture opened its photography gallery and headquarters across from the Natural History Museum.
• The Library for the Performing Arts got $60 million, the largest gift in its history.
• Golf v.2 opens Nov. 2 at 1865 Broadway, for people who need to golf inside.

Links to every story are in our bio.
